simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to עָגוּר (H5693) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: עָגוּר (ʻâgûwr) means probably the swallow First listed occurrence: Isa 38 14.

definitions.full: H5693. agur עָגוּר noun [masculine] apparently understood by Masoretes as name of a bird; very uncertain; crane according to Saad (Isaiah), but note of crane not suitable (Tristr NHB 239 f. ); — וְעָגוּר וְסוּס וְתוֺר Jer 8:7 ; עָגוּר כְּסוּס Isa 38:14 (but here gloss Klo Brd Di Dn Che Hpt ); Thes and (in Jeremiah) Hi Gf Gie strike out וְ and take ׳ע as adjective of סוס = twittering or the like; Thes assumes transpos. from גער , Ethiopic cry . I, II, III. עַד see I. עדה . עֵד see עוד . עֹד see עוֺד . עִדֹּא see עדד . below, עדד (√ of following; compare Arabic count, reckon , number, period ; Aramaic עִדָּנָא time ).
definitions.rootNote: passive part (but with active sense) of an unused root meaning to twitter ;
